title: Each flow carries a goal and the number it moves, counted from the flow's own rows
description: Hub model (2026-11-11): every flow answers to one number, or the brain has nothing to decide against. The Owner sets a goal per flow: metric (sent, replies, signups, hosts, paid), a whole-number target, a period (week = last 7 days, month = last 30 days) and an optional label. Progress is counted, never estimated: sent and replies from the flow's drafts (sent_at, replied_at inside the period), signups, hosts and paid from the outcomes Frequency sends back. A metric with nothing to count shows 0. The goal lives in the Supervisor settings beside the dial, so it survives a restart, and { target: null } clears it. POST /v1/supervisor/flows/{key}/goal (CLI token or paired session) sets it and every FlowView gains goal: null or { metric, target, period, label, progress: { value, as_of } }. The flow card shows the goal and its progress; the Monday staff meeting and the game read the same number. Wave 3 of the master plan v2.
acceptance: Every FlowView has goal null on a fresh home
POST /v1/supervisor/flows/{key}/goal sets it; no session 401, unknown flow 404, a bad metric, target, period or label 400
progress.value counts only rows inside the period: three replies this week and one from 40 days ago give 3
The goal survives a restart, sits on its own flow only, and target null clears it
